state_note: Hypotheses are recorded separately from the source claims that motivated them and from the reproductions that tested them. Each derived hypothesis and every fixture expectation was written into hidden_state_fixtures.py before the first fixture-matrix execution.

primary.statement: A two-checkout differential run can expose dependencies on untracked files, environment leakage, or warm caches.
primary.exact_falsifier: For any of the three classes, a workload whose outcome depends on that class alone produces identical normalised outcomes in the warm and clean checkouts, or the runner cannot say which class caused an observed divergence.
primary.outcome_evidence: Six warm-only green mutants across the three classes were each detected and attributed to the correct single class, with the interaction case attributed to both necessary classes; see fixture-matrix-result.json and reproduction-result.json.

derived.statement: Replaying the clean checkout with exactly one class of the warm checkout's hidden state re-applied is sufficient to attribute a divergence to that class.
derived.exact_falsifier: A single-class replay fails to reproduce the warm outcome digest for a workload that depends on that class alone, or reproduces it for a class the workload does not use.
derived.evidence: untracked-file-dependency, environment-leakage, warm-cache-repo-local and warm-cache-external-home each produced a sufficient-alone single-class probe; the two clean controls produced no finding at all.

derived.statement: Presence of hidden state is not itself evidence of dependence, so a workload that ignores present hidden state must produce no finding.
derived.exact_falsifier: The clean-control fixture with all three classes present reports any attributed class or any divergence.
derived.evidence: clean-control-contaminated-but-unused reports class_present true for all three classes and verdict NO_HIDDEN_STATE_DEPENDENCY_DETECTED with zero attributed classes.

derived.statement: Intrinsic nondeterminism is separable from hidden-state dependence by repeating the command within each side before comparing sides.
derived.exact_falsifier: A workload that is nondeterministic in both checkouts is reported as depending on a hidden-state class.
derived.evidence: nondeterministic-command yields NONDETERMINISTIC_COMMAND with no probes at repeats>=2. The condition is measured, not assumed: at repeats=1 the control is blind, which test_determinism_control_requires_more_than_one_run_per_side asserts rather than hides.

derived.statement: Outcome-differential detection cannot observe hidden state that is read without changing the observable outcome.
derived.exact_falsifier: The silent-read fixture is reported as a hidden-state dependency.
derived.evidence: silent-hidden-state-dependency reads an untracked file, writes a scratch file and returns the same stdout and exit code on both sides; the verdict is NO_HIDDEN_STATE_DEPENDENCY_DETECTED. This is recorded as a bound of the mechanism, not as a pass.

derived.statement: For deterministic workloads the classification is itself deterministic, so an independent rerun yields the same classification digest.
derived.exact_falsifier: Two independent matrix runs disagree on any verdict, or disagree on the classification digest of any deterministic fixture.
derived.evidence: Two full matrix runs agreed on all 11 verdicts and on 10 of 11 classification digests; the single differing digest is the nondeterministic fixture, whose outcome digest cannot be stable by construction and whose verdict still recurred.

derived.statement: A divergence caused by state outside the three declared classes must be reported as unattributed rather than blamed on a present-but-innocent class.
derived.exact_falsifier: A divergence caused by checkout ref state or modified tracked content is attributed to untracked files, environment or cache.
derived.evidence: unattributed-git-ref-state carries a decoy untracked file and still returns HIDDEN_STATE_DEPENDENCY_UNATTRIBUTED with an empty attribution and a failed closure probe; unattributed-modified-tracked-file returns the same verdict and names MODIFIED_TRACKED_CONTENT as an out-of-scope candidate.

derived.statement: Comparing raw command output is insufficient, because volatile text a command emits about itself diverges without any hidden state being involved.
derived.exact_falsifier: A workload that emits only a fresh duration and wall-clock timestamp alongside a fixed result produces identical raw outcomes on both sides.
derived.frozen_after_first_execution_note: This hypothesis was not frozen before the first matrix run. It was raised by self-application after the matrix already passed, and it is recorded as a later addition rather than backdated.
derived.evidence: Self-application at commit 891a5e6df0776272c9391bcf48db53fff6993121 misattributed a unittest timing difference to ENVIRONMENT_LEAKAGE; the clean-control-volatile-output fixture is CLEAN with scrubbing and not CLEAN with scrubbing disabled.
